name: koin-flow-scope
description: Team standard for passing data between screens in a Kotlin Multiplatform app with shared ViewModels and Koin: one Koin scope per multi-screen flow holding a FlowData object. Start with fresh data, read in loadInitData, write before navigating, close on finish and on cancel, survive process death, iOS via KoinHelper, tests and a migration checklist for replacing navigation arguments.
